D3 ruling rule G4a, a dated amendment (17 October, D3a-10), forward only. An add-condition or add-step line whose condition or step the element itself states is a specification (as G9 rules restrict lines). One whose condition or step another element or arrow already states is a specification of its element, the reason naming the other id; it is not an elaboration, because nothing new enters the model. One whose condition is a rule for coding or counting, not something members did, is ruled by its concepts alone. One that no part of the model states, shown in the room's concepts, is a paired elaboration where a second room shows it and a particular where only one does (G4, G6), and the search for a second room is part of the ruling. It applies from D3a-10 forward and does not apply backwards; the earlier rulings stand. Cause: the D3a-10 blind check, where 3 of 4 add-condition pairs disagreed on this boundary. Question QD3-003 to J on applying it backwards

D3 ruling rule G17, for P16, written before its lines are ruled. P16 is shown when a concept shows help passing between rooms, read from either room's record: members giving pixels to, repairing or defending another room's work, or another room's members arriving to help the room's work; asking another room for help, or another room's request arriving (a call addressed to kindred rooms for the room's work shows P01 and P16's request at once); help offered, asked or kept in return for help, space or repair (barter), whose settled terms show P08's deal at once; thanks to another room for help, or the alliance's story (which rooms stood with the room), which shows P11's credit at once where the help went to the room's work; greetings, compliments, condolences or love addressed to another room or its work; a neighbour's work adopting the room's, with thanks or offers; refusing or turning back another room's request, including the general canvas requests that reach a room. P16 does not require that help be delivered or verified: asking, offering and bartering are its acts. Another community's chat or group counts as a room here (the unit is a room or a group of rooms). It is not shown by: borders, truces and deals that are not about help (P08); sparing, reining in attackers or apology (P07); attacks (P09); forming an alliance, shared chat or joint mark as such (P17), though help given or asked within one shows P16; calls to the room's own members only (P01); a wish or proposal inside the room to ask another room, with no request made; a retrospective wish that help had been asked; help among members of one room. Under G9 a restrict line corrects P16 only if its condition is one P16 does not state and the room's concepts show P16 failing without it; a line saying that an offer or request is not delivered help corrects nothing. G4a rules add-condition and add-step lines. Under G2 an absent line is rejected when its concepts show P16; P16 is not universal, so its absent lines are never corrections; G3 rules evidenced absences.
